item.title: Project Valhalla's First Preview: JEP 401 Redefines == for Java Objects
item.description: JEP 401, integrated into JDK 28, introduces value objects. These new class instances feature final fields, altered behavior for equality checks, and stricter construction and synchronization rules. (1 source: infoq)
